summary: Enhance your financial expertise with our comprehensive training course on financial markets and institutions. Learn from industry experts and boost your career
lede: Financial markets show how funds move through banks and markets, while institutional roles and policy channels affect pricing, liquidity and risk. For treasury, finance, risk and investment operations professionals, the course supports practical analysis of short-term funding, bond yields and rate sensitivity, bank risk profiles, and market updates for clearer financial decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need a practical, foundation-to-intermediate grasp of financial markets and institutions to make clearer financial decisions and communicate with confidence.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation includes basic numeracy, comfort with spreadsheets, and a general understanding of business finance. No programming is required, and the course is taught at conceptual and operational level rather than technical engineering level. Prior exposure to accounting, treasury, banking, investment operations, or financial reporting will help you move faster, but it is not mandatory.
